method: Seed17, 60Hz deterministic simulation using current Crown per-type prices. Greedy route-contact pose search through ordinary paid placement, every affordable purchase at setup, no bonus scrap or recalls. Active pilot uses bounded steering/thrust pursuit only on carrier waves, from one idealized legal E staging pose; idle otherwise. Two-field comparator buys fields in slots9/12 and selects nonoverlapping centers for damage overlap. Optional --roles comparator adds four Halo, two Pin and two Stasis after its initial eight Pierce, then resumes Pierce purchases. Halo centers maximize 5m sphere route coverage; Pin lines use its own finite-cylinder coverage as a placement proxy, not a prediction of nearest-target shot damage. Setup placements are instantaneous idealized poses. Not human difficulty, browser QA or optimal play.
